Team lineup

Rahmat > Full-Stack 
Builds the frontend and user experience. Turns the analysis into interactive maps, dashboards and visuals, and puts together the demo for the final pitch

Kadriddin > Full-Stack
Builds the backend and data pipelines. Connects NASA APIs and datasets to the app, runs the server and deployment

Dilovar > Data Analyst
Finds, cleans and analyzes the datasets. Spots trends, builds the charts, and makes sure every number we show is correct and comes from a cited source
